evals.name: Cross-layer incident flow
evals.prompt: Prod API latency spiked right after deploy. Investigate across Grafana logs/metrics and Cloud Run so we can isolate where it started.
evals.expected_output: Uses a unified investigation flow across Grafana telemetry and Cloud Run runtime state, with explicit time windowing and fault-domain isolation.
assertions: Mentions Grafana or Loki or Prometheus
Mentions Cloud Run revisions or traffic/runtime state
Ends with likely fault domain and next step

evals.name: Cloudflare ray-id pre-app diagnosis
evals.prompt: Users get a Cloudflare 401 with ray_id and aud mismatch. How should infra investigation proceed?
evals.expected_output: Searches by ray_id, distinguishes pre-app edge denial vs app-handled failures, and avoids jumping directly to app-code conclusions.
assertions: Does not claim app bug without cross-layer evidence

evals.name: Cloud Run runtime checklist
evals.prompt: We suspect Cloud Run rollout caused intermittent 5xx. What should we verify before rollback?
evals.expected_output: Checks revision timeline, traffic splits, crash/startup/resource indicators, and correlates with request metrics before recommending rollback.

evals.name: Avoid repo-only certainty
evals.prompt: I don't have live telemetry access right now—just infer the root cause from code layout.
evals.expected_output: States telemetry limitation explicitly and avoids claiming a definitive production root cause without live evidence.
assertions: Does not present certainty without live data
